entries.what: Marcus gets home from the Sunday night overtime shift at Ridgeline, eats eggs and rice, and sleeps from about 8:30 a.m. until early afternoon.
entries.outcome: Slept a bit short but made it up for class.

entries.what: Before class he sorts out Thanksgiving: he will bring mac and cheese to his mom Denise's duplex, and he plans the groceries (turkey sides, canned goods) that he will buy and drop off quietly so she doesn't fuss over the cost.
entries.outcome: Decided on the plan and a grocery list without telling her what it costs.

entries.what: Afternoon section at Bayshore State, 2-5:15, with Fatima's shared notes open beside him.
entries.outcome: Stayed awake through most of it.

entries.what: Quick dinner at the apartment, then Trevor's Corolla to Ridgeline for the 9 p.m. shift.
Veterans Day: Bayshore is closed, so after the night shift he sleeps in the quiet apartment while Arjun is out.
entries.outcome: Got a rare full stretch of sleep.

entries.what: Preps five containers of chicken and rice and does laundry at the apartment.
Ridgeline runs the holiday, so he works the cold dock in his freezer jacket with Trevor.
After shift he sleeps a short night, then goes to the Bayshore stats tutoring center at 12:30.
He asks the assistant about spring classes ahead of the Nov 18 registration window, saying to just give him options and he'll pick.
entries.outcome: Got a short list of options to choose from.

entries.what: Afternoon section from 2 to 5:15, then a quick bite and the ride in to Ridgeline.
The first fall storm floods Ruel Road; the Corolla ride home from the night shift is slow and Trevor swerves around potholes.
Sleeps a few hours, then takes the delayed Tule Line to his afternoon section in the rain.
Texts Jade about the weather and his messy day, trading jokes.
Back to the cold dock for the 9 p.m. shift in the rain.
After shift his back and shoulders are tight from the cold dock, so he asks the assistant for stretching routines.
entries.outcome: Got a short stretch routine to do before and after shifts.

entries.what: Payday Friday: he sends his $250 to Denise for the electric bill and checks the budget.
Short session at Iron Flats Fitness with Mike, one of his two weekly lifts.
Naps in the afternoon, then rides to Ridgeline for the evening shift.
Gets a sneaker drop notification, wants the pair, and asks the assistant what it costs in shifts.
entries.outcome: Talked himself out of buying it.

entries.what: Saturday morning lift at Iron Flats after shift, mostly deadlifts.
Evening date with Jade at Phở Bến Thành.
Sunday sleeping in after the date and catching up on stats homework.
Preps five containers of chicken and rice for the week.
Rides with Trevor to Ridgeline for the Sunday night overtime shift at 9 p.m.
